cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Comfort Everyone Else
cards.instruction: Meet every painful moment by comforting someone else more intensely while your own distress becomes harder to hide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I've brought tissues. Being laid off together doesn't make your day any easier.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're wiping your eyes on your sleeve.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I'm saving the soft ones for you. Tell me what you're worried about.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You. You can't even get the tissue box open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then take the whole box. I'll make tea once my hands stop doing this.
